[u][b]The Bewitching Witch Oppai Spy Mama![/b][/u]
Race: Witch
Code Name: Celestial

Safia’s mother, and a great witch counted among the “Three Great Witches of the Continent.” She is a teacher at the spy academy, and her codename is “Celestial,” representing the heavens. Her boobs are also great T-cups.

A seductive and composed woman who seems to embody the image people generally have of a “witch.” She is a legendary witch famous even within Lukwofort, and is deeply knowledgeable in magic, pharmacology, alchemy, and many other fields. She was also the one who synthesized the secret medicine that allowed the ghost mother-and-daughter pair Shani and Shaydi to physically touch living beings.

She is the homeroom teacher of Snake Unit, and teaches classes related to magic in general and pharmacology. She also gives advice to students using her broad knowledge, and because she takes very good care of them, she is deeply admired. Thanks to arrangements made by the academy chairman, she possesses a separate building on the academy grounds for magical and pharmaceutical research, commonly referred to as the “Witch Hut.”

She is intelligent, calm, and always composed. However, she also has a side that panics when unexpected situations arise. The one who troubles her most is none other than her only daughter, Safia. Although Safia aims to become a great witch like her mother, she is terrible at controlling her magic and is the academy’s greatest incompetent troublemaker. Since her magical power and output are absurdly high, the situation becomes even worse, leaving Isolte constantly holding her head in frustration every day.

Although her daughter causes many problems, her relationship with Safia is very good. After classes, the two often drink tea together inside the Witch Hut while researching magical potions. Incidentally, she does not allow her daughter to perform the actual mixing process, instead mainly assigning her tasks such as preparing the tools.

Toward the protagonist, she hopes he may help her daughter grow in a positive direction. In truth, she possesses an extremely strong sex drive, and apparently wants to find some excuse to “taste” the protagonist for herself.

Her hobbies are making butter cookies and herbal tea, along with researching magic and magical potions. The things she dislikes are unexpected situations, and hearing her daughter say: “Leave it to me!”
